mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity that reduces recession risk and supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where INDPRO shows a positive month-over-month change.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.2 percentage points over the past month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months where UNRATE rises by more than 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.2% and FEDFUNDS monthly change > 0.1%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.2% and FEDFUNDS monthly change > 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market recovery (HOUST above 1800 thousand units) and strong consumer spending (RSAFS above 360000 million dollars), robust demand growth boosts corporate earnings and supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: housing market recovery and strong consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 1800 and RSAFS > 360000.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates rising inflation that typically leads to higher interest rates and reduced equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months where CPIAUCSL shows a positive month-over-month change.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1900 thousand units, it signals strong residential construction activity that boosts economic growth and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where HOUST exceeds 1900.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and increases in unemployment (UNRATE) signal a severe labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS monthly change < -0.5% and UNRATE monthly change > 0.1%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines by more than 0.5% and UNRATE rises by more than 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO below 110 index) and rising unemployment (UNRATE above 5.0%), a dual shock of weak production and labor market deterioration triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: dual shock (manufacturing slowdown and labor market deterioration)
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO is below 110 and UNRATE is above 5.0.
